correctness.rationale: Exact torsion expansion gives complementary Lie subalgebras; the trace-form and 1-dimensional centralizer classify all 2D sl2 Lie subalgebras as Borels for every odd q. The Borel action explicitly transforms u=b+a² to t²u and has exactly three orbits. Counting Borel cosets and stabilizers derives the eight global orbits. Rank-involution N↦I−N and affine-fibre geometry close all cases. Standalone checker covers q=3,5,7,9, with full ambient enumeration over F3 and full PGL2 orbits over q=3,5; infinite claim rests on proof.
